title: Mariie & [Partner Name]
text:
We’re getting married


[Month Day, 2027] · Northern Arizona
We can’t wait to celebrate with you among the pines. This weekend brings together the people we love most for a few days of good food, good company, and (hopefully) a crisp mountain evening or two.
Everything you need is here: the schedule, where to stay, and how to RSVP. If anything is unclear, just reach out to us directly.

title: Gifts
text:
Your presence is the gift. If you’d still like to give something, here are the two ways to do that. They support different things, so we’ve kept them separate.


Honeymoon Fund
We’re skipping a traditional registry. If you’d like to contribute toward our honeymoon, this goes directly toward the trip.
Give to the honeymoon fund →


Room & Board
If you’re staying with us on-property, this is a voluntary way to help cover the cost of your stay. Entirely optional, no pressure either way.
Contribute to room & board →
